cohort: 28 term neonates with CHD and MRI-confirmed acute perinatal stroke born between 2007-2017 in the Central-Hungarian Region, compared to two control groups of 56 infants each (CHD without stroke and stroke without CHD)
finding: Neonates with both CHD and perinatal stroke had a higher mortality rate compared to those with CHD alone, and both groups with stroke had similar rates of adverse neurodevelopmental outcomes.
